summary: Bistro / festoon lights: a sagging black cable between two freestanding poles with pendant sockets every ~0.6… options mounts, bulb, tone; sockets socket_end_l, socket_end_r, socket_mid.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.festoon_light_string or place "prefab": "festoon_light_string" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
